# Cookie Policy

**Last Updated:** Feb. 25th, 2026

This Cookie Policy applies to the Scratch Space website operated by Bruker Spatial Biology. This page explains how and why we use cookies on this specific site, and how you can manage your preferences. For Bruker Spatial Biology's comprehensive cookie policy, please visit the [Bruker Spatial Biology Corporate Cookie Policy](https://brukerspatialbiology.com/about-us/legal/cookies-policy/).

### What are cookies?
Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to the owners of the site.

### How we use cookies on this site
Because this is a documentation and scratch space site, we keep our cookie usage minimal. We do not use advertising, targeting, or cross-site tracking cookies. The cookies we do use fall into two categories:

**1. Strictly Necessary Cookies**
These cookies are essential for the website's consent mechanism to function properly and cannot be switched off in our systems. 

| Cookie Name | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `cookie_consent_user_accepted` | Remembers whether you have interacted with the cookie banner. |
| `cookie_consent_level` | Stores your specific preferences (e.g., whether you accepted tracking cookies). |
| `cookie_consent_user_consent_token` | A randomly generated token that logs your consent status securely. |

**2. Performance and Analytics Cookies**
With your consent, we use these cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website. This includes monitoring site performance, seeing which pages are most popular, and tracking interactions with specific site features (such as button clicks, file downloads, or form interactions). 

| Cookie Name | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `_ga` | Used by Google Analytics to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. |
| `_ga_[ID]` | Used by Google Analytics to maintain session state and track the pages you visit within our site. (Note: The `[ID]` represents a unique container ID for our analytics property). |

### Managing your cookie preferences
You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies on this site. 

* **Website Preference Center:** You can adjust your preferences at any time by clicking the "Cookie Preferences" link located in the footer of this website. If you toggle off "Tracking cookies," our Google Analytics scripts will be disabled.
* **Browser Controls:** You can set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies. If you choose to reject strictly necessary cookies via your browser, you may still use our website, though some minor functionality (like remembering your consent) may be impaired.

### Contact Us
If you have any questions about our use of cookies on this specific site, please contact `support.spatial@bruker.com`. For broader inquiries regarding Bruker Spatial Biology's data practices, please refer to our main [Corporate Privacy Policy](https://brukerspatialbiology.com/about-us/legal/privacy-policy/).
